data.long_meaning: The name Sheen is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chandra Shekhar' which means 'God of the Moon'. It is a beautiful and elegant name with deep spiritual significance. In Hindu mythology, the Goddess of the Moon, Chandra, is often depicted as having a radiant, shining face, which is symbolic of the name Sheen. The name Sheen carries the meaning “Goddess of the Moon” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi, Marathi. Parents who choose Sheen usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of the moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Sheen represents the divine feminine energy, the power of the moon, and the inner glow of a woman. It is a name that signifies beauty, grace, and strength.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sheen total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
